title: cost-optimization: autotune batching/caching defaults + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: This PR implements the next phase of our cost optimization automation work: sensible defaults for batching and KV caching, a pluggable quantization profile pipeline, and first-class unit-economics tooling integrated into the Optimize service and Redwood Console. Motivation: customers see wide variance in per-token cost from suboptimal batching/caching policies and manual quantization selections. This change streamlines defaults + adds telemetry and a UI surface for unit-econ decisions. Changes: 1) Autotune defaults: add a new defaults layer in autoscaler that proposes per-model batching window, max_batch_size, and aggressive_prefix_cache settings. Defaults are heuristics derived from production workload samples and can be overridden per-deployment. 2) KV caching: enable prefix/KV caching by default for streaming chat models with max_cached_prefix_length configurable. 3) Quant profiles: introduce QuantProfile model with quantization presets (int8, nf4, awq-lite) and a short evaluation harness to estimate quality/cost tradeoffs. Profiles are pluggable and can be attached to rollout policies. 4) Unit-econ tooling: new /optimize/api endpoint returns estimated cost/token, projected monthly spend, and recommended config changes. Console: add Cost Insights panel listing recommended actions and simulated savings for top-10 routes. 5) CLI & SDK: expose autotune preview and apply commands in redwoodctl and python/sdk. 6) Tests & benchmarks: end-to-end integration tests plus a microbenchmark harness showing median 28% cost reduction on sampled workloads. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag `autotune_cost_defaults_v2`; default OFF for enterprise customers until 2026-04 to allow compliance review. Checklist: - [x] Implement autoscale defaults and caching heuristics - [x] Add quant profile models and evaluation harness - [x] Build unit-econ API and console panel - [x] Add SDK/CLI bindings - [x] Add integration tests and perf benchmarks - [x] Add docs and Linear tickets. Related: Linear ENG-9842, ENG-9875, PM-410. Breaking changes: none expected; all changes opt-in or behind feature flags.

Emma Chen (review): Console panel UX looks good; please ensure recommended actions have an estimated confidence score and a link to the exact rollout config change.
Aisha Patel (reply): Added confidence field and config_snapshot link in the simulation table. Also added unit tests for the config snapshot serialization.

release_notes: Added autotune defaults for batching and KV caching, pluggable quantization profiles, unit-economics estimator and Console Cost Insights panel. Improvements reduce median per-token cost by ~28% on sampled workloads. Feature behind feature flag autotune_cost_defaults_v2.
